run_poststratify_basic: run poststratify on sample and target DataFrames to compute adjusted weights matching target distribution
run_poststratify_with_formula: run poststratify using a formula like 'gender:age_group' to select interaction variables for weight adjustment
run_sample_adjust_poststratify: run Sample.adjust with method poststratify to rebalance sample weights against a target population
run_poststratify_weight_trimming: run poststratify with weight_trimming_mean_ratio or weight_trimming_percentile to clip extreme weights
run_poststratify_na_handling: run poststratify with na_action set to add_indicator or drop to handle missing values in variables
